findings.label: Enum migration not yet generated
findings.detail: The ALTER TYPE "audit_action" ADD VALUE 'LOGOUT' migration must be produced by the user via db:generate/db:migrate before these writes succeed at runtime. By design — the task defers all CLI to the user; migration 0007_easy_morph.sql present on disk is the unrelated ACL/ROUTE exec-log migration, not this one.

findings.label: Unrelated work bundled in the working tree
findings.detail: The on-disk diff also contains the ACL/ROUTE two-table + exec-log task (new acl-logs/route-logs schema, services, repos, endpoints, migration 0007, administration/users edits). None of it is part of the AUTH changeset; the AUTH task touched only the 4 auth endpoints + audit enum + client enum + the one Log Trail filter option, and did not touch user.service.ts or administration auditing.
